title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is The Beatles' “Michelle” — a gentle, French-flavored love ballad off 1965's Rubber Soul, with Paul McCartney's soft croon and that unforgettable “Michelle, ma belle” refrain. It's romantic, tender, and instantly recognizable, bringing a quiet, wistful warmth to a Djembe set.
songListNote: Song of the Week — The Beatles' tender, romantic “Michelle” joins the request catalog this week.
